title: Wellness Visit Overdue by Pet
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vet:visit pet_name=* visit_type="wellness" visit_date=*
| stats max(visit_date) as last_wellness by pet_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-strptime(last_wellness,"%Y-%m-%d"))/86400,0)
| where days_since>365
| sort - days_since
| table pet_name days_since last_wellness
description: Flags pets whose last wellness visit was more than twelve months ago.
value: Annual wellness visits catch chronic conditions early when treatment is cheaper and less stressful.
implementation: Log wellness visits with ISO `visit_date` and `pet_name`, then alert when the interval exceeds one year.
visualization: Table of pets by days since last wellness visit.
grandmaExplanation: It counts pets that are overdue for their yearly checkup at the vet.
